title: rpg-classic world
description: The open-world document: the moment-of-day bands, the portal gates, and the atlas/tint style variants. Nothing here is engine-native. The engine has a day/night clock (daynight.getTimeOfDay / isNight) but no notion of a triggered world gate, and it has no event on the clock, so the project polls it. The design rule this schema encodes is that 'not yet open' is a CONDITION, not missing content: a gated portal stays in the object layer so a human and an agent can both read 'this door exists, but is locked' out of the documents. `gates[].open` reuses eve.rpgc.condition by whole-schema reference, so the gate vocabulary cannot drift from the event vocabulary. See docs/06-game-design.md §1.
